# Triaged false positives. Every entry here was traced by hand; anything that
# is not provably a cppcheck limitation belongs in the source, not in this file.
# Entries are scoped by check id and file, not by line, so they survive code
# moving around inside the file.

# desktop_sort_in() takes the slot as a parameter, so cppcheck analyses it with
# `slot` unconstrained and concludes it can reach MAX_DESKTOPS. Its only caller,
# desktop_create(), returns early on `g.desktop_count >= MAX_DESKTOPS` before
# taking the slot, so `slot` is at most MAX_DESKTOPS - 1 on entry.
arrayIndexOutOfBoundsCond:src/desktop.c

# The free(desc_w) sites in bind_value() are each followed by luaL_error(),
# which longjmps out and never returns. cppcheck 2.13 does not honour a library
# <noreturn> definition in its doubleFree check, so it walks straight through
# the call into the next free.
doubleFree:src/lua_api.c

# tile_monitor()'s compaction loop only ever does `cs[keep++] = cs[i]` with
# 0 <= keep <= i, so the index cannot go negative. cppcheck reaches -1 by
# reasoning backwards from the later `if (n == 0)` to a pre-increment value of
# -1, instead of concluding the loop body simply never ran.
negativeIndex:src/tiling.c
